# XHelpers Pro 1.0.10 (20)
- Import and update public YouTube playlists without signing in to Google or supplying developer credentials. Public details use the publisher's service after a separate privacy disclosure. - YouTube account connection, account playlists and Liked Videos are not available in this version. Existing account imports and saved access remain on this Mac, but account items cannot be refreshed or played. You can remove saved access locally and manage Google's authorization in Google Account permissions. - Public imports show short service cooldowns and can be cancelled. Saved playlist structure survives temporary service failures and the account feature's unavailability; cached API information still expires. - Improve seeking and queue transitions in Apple Music and YouTube playback. Supported, unprotected files in your Music library can use the local player with its own seek and volume controls. - Discover playlists from your Apple Music library and improve library table selection, hover feedback, and column sizing in narrower windows. - Keep video geometry stable when expanding or collapsing the player, preserve chosen window and queue sizes, and refine the shared volume controls. - Mark cleanup tools as early previews and show a persistent notice in their dialogs.
YouTube's visible player, video availability and playback restrictions still apply. Protected or streaming Apple Music items continue to use MusicKit; per-player volume adjustment is unavailable for those items.
